repository.name: @webex/internal-plugin-flag
repository.purpose: Internal Webex JS SDK plugin registered as webex.internal.flag. Importing it imports @webex/internal-plugin-conversation and @webex/internal-plugin-device for their side effects and registers the Flag plugin with an empty config under the flag key. Flag creates and lists activity flags through catalog service userApps (resource /flags), archives, unflags, or deletes a flag through its url, and maps flags to activities with one bulk_activities_fetch request per conversation URL whose prefix the service catalog names as service conversation.

public_interfaces.name: @webex/internal-plugin-flag package barrel
public_interfaces.audience: sibling packages webex-server and recipe-private-web-client (import for side effect); any application that imports the package
public_interfaces.notes: Importing the package imports @webex/internal-plugin-conversation and @webex/internal-plugin-device for their side effects and registers Flag as internal plugin 'flag' with config {flag: {}}. Only the default export exists.

public_interfaces.name: webex.internal.flag methods
public_interfaces.audience: applications built on the Webex JS SDK
public_interfaces.notes: create, archive, unflag, and delete reject when the required url field is missing. The options argument is nested under a request key and does not change the request. mapToActivities sends a bulk fetch only to conversation hosts named by the service catalog. See src/docs/README.md.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not send the mapToActivities bulk fetch to a URL built from flag-item without checking the host against the service catalog.
negative_guidance.why: The INV-003 check keeps activity URLs from being posted to an unknown host; the unit cases marked SECURITY pin it. archive, unflag, and delete send to flag.url without a host check today; adding one is a separate, tested behavior change.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not pass request settings through the options argument of the flag methods.
negative_guidance.why: The methods nest options under a request key and do not merge it, so headers, qs, and other transport settings there are not applied (MOD-009). The conversation inbound predicates read deferDecrypt from the request's top level, not from the nested object.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not describe the README usage line webex.internal.flag.WHATEVER as an API.
negative_guidance.why: It is a placeholder; the methods are listed in src/docs/README.md. See docs/adr/0001-retain-product-readme.md.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not infer a coverage threshold for this package.
negative_guidance.why: No coverage gate applies: jest-config-legacy sets collectCoverage false and package.json has no coverage script.

high.expectation: Source and unit test evidence both support the change, for example the url guards and the mapToActivities host check.

medium.expectation: Only source evidence or the live integration spec exists, for example the request shapes of create, list, archive, unflag, and delete, and the '200' filter. Pin current behavior with a characterization test before modifying.

low.expectation: Neither source nor tests settle the question, for example the user-apps service's paging or status formats. Stop and report the gap.
